name: Mahila Nirman Shramik Vivah Yojana
benefit: - **A one-time grant of ₹50,000/- is provided to meet the marriage expenses of the female registered construction worker and a maximum of two daughters of a registered construction worker.**
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a female registered construction worker. 
1. The female construction worker should have been registered for at least one year continuously.
1. The family of a registered construction worker can avail of this assistance only twice: however, there shall be only one claim in respect of a given marriage irrespective of the number of registered construction workers in the family.
1. The registered construction workers should not have any dues payable to the Board.
1. The registered construction worker's daughter should have attained the age prescribed by law for marriage for whose marriage the assistance is sought.  
1. The registered construction worker's daughter should not be an employee in government or quasi-government.
